topic: Rocks turned Loki away every time he asked to join, and that refusal shaped Loki's whole path (side point of the curse long)
title: Rocks Turned Loki Away Every Single Time (1158)
description: Loki begged to join Rocks on every visit and heard no every time. Chapter 1158 shows how that refusal shaped the giant prince. Do you think Rocks was cruel or protecting him?
comment: Did Rocks refuse Loki out of cruelty, or because he saw the curse in him? Pick one.

lines.text: Loki begged Rocks to take him aboard, and Rocks said no every single time.
